title: Portfolio
descriptionGame: This is a fast-paced game where players compete to catch a Google badge on a grid. Control your characters, catch up to the target and score points faster than your opponent. Customize the difficulty by changing the field size and victory conditions. Perfect for fun competitions with friends or practicing your reactions.
descriptionNextPizza: Next Pizza is a full-stack pizza delivery e-commerce platform. It features a product catalog with filtering and search, a shopping cart and checkout system, authentication via social networks and email, online payment processing, a personal account with order history, and an admin panel for product management. Built with NextJS, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, Prisma, NextAuth, Zustand, and Yookassa. Integrated with a payment system and email notification service. The project is currently in active development.
descriptionCheckFlow: The "Check Flow" project provides a convenient interface for creating, editing, deleting, and displaying tasks and to-do lists. Users can easily add new tasks, set their completion status.
descriptionHomeStore: HomeStore is an online furniture store that is under active development.
